proposal.title: Disable MASP rewards for legacy IBC channel tokens
proposal.abstract: Disable MASP rewards on the IBC tokens originating from the old, compromised channels.
proposal.motivation: This proposal disables rewards on legacy tokens.
proposal.details: For each IBC token, this proposal sets the MASP max reward rate to zero, essentially disabling reward minting from MASP conversions.
proposal.author: tnam1qxfj3sf6a0meahdu9t6znp05g8zx4dkjtgyn9gfu
